nodes.speaker: Pip
nodes.text: Oh. You're the doodle from the page.

nodes.speaker: Pip
nodes.text: I was reading a book and then I wasn't. It was scary. But I think I finished a chapter.

nodes.speaker: Pip
nodes.text: Mister Garrick says you can swing a quill. Will you show me how to hold one? I want to write the next page myself.
[i]He is smiling at the sky, where the underside of the next page is very faintly beginning to show text. It is not an ending. It is a sentence that starts with "Once."[/i]
